weekday lunch diaries 
steamed rice | gujarati kadhi | aloo fry 

if you want the recipe for my Gujarati Kadhi, drop a comment below and i shall share it sooo

A meal featuring Gujarati kadhi, rice, and aloo fry isn’t just a culinary experience; it’s a journey through flavors that evoke a myriad of emotions and memories for me personally. 

At its core, this meal embodies comfort. The soothing warmth of the kadhi, with its tangy and subtly sweet flavors, wraps around you like a familiar embrace. It’s the kind of comfort that brings a sense of contentment and nostalgia, reminding me of the many home-cooked meals enjoyed at my school classmates traditional gujarati homes growing up.
It truly was something we looked forward to quite often along with a plethoral of various dishes you just didnt get at your own home! 
Eating this meal truly brings pure joy.

In essence, a meal of Gujarati kadhi, rice, and aloo fry isn’t just about the food—it’s about the emotions it stirs, the memories it invokes, and the connections it strengthens. It’s a celebration of culture, friendship, looking back at happy times and valuing simple pleasures of life.
